Architecture:
- Backend: Express API in `backend/`, entry `backend/index.js`; routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`. `RepositoryFactory` switches JSON-file/Mongo implementations. Menu controllers use multer `upload.single("image")`.
- Frontend: React app in `frontend/`, client code `frontend/src/`; admin UI `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (example `adminhomes.jsx`); API client `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, and detects `FormData` (do not set `Content-Type` manually).
- Image storage is local filesystem or Cloudinary, configured by `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`). JWT auth uses browser local-storage tokens; the API client includes `credentials: 'include'` (always double check this).

Read first:
- `backend/src/routes/*.js`, especially `upload.single("image")`
- `backend/src/controllers/*`
- `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`
- `backend/.env.examples`
- `frontend/src/lib/api.js`: detects `FormData`, avoids `Content-Type`, sends `credentials: 'include'`, and unwraps inconsistent responses.
- `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`

Conventions:
- Use `RepositoryFactory` for data operations.
- Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in production — code includes a development fallback but expects httpOnly cookies.
- Multipart routes require `multipart/form-data`; the frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData (the client `api.js` handles this). Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation.
- Tests are in `backend/src/__tests__`, using `supertest`, `backend/index.js`, and sometimes repository factories.

Workflows:
When running backend npm tests locally always comment out the `MONGO_URI` environment variable in the `.env` file at the `./backend` folder make sure it was not declared and just un-comment it back after testing, Also skip cloudinary test cases if at least one of the following environment variables is not set, is empty or is not present in the `.env` file: `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` and `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`.
- Inspect root `package.json`, `backend/package.json`, `frontend/package.json` for scripts.
- Backend dev: `cd backend && npm run dev`
- Frontend dev: `cd frontend && npm start`
- Tests: `cd backend && npm test`
- CI: `.github/workflows/` (`backend-ci.yml`, `frontend-ci.yml`).
